name: Moules Frites

cookwares.name: 6- to 8-quart Dutch oven or large pot

instructions.primary_message: In a 6- to 8-quart Dutch oven or large pot set over medium-low heat, melt butter. Add shallots and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until very softened but not browned, 8 to 10 minutes.

Increase heat to high, add wine, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes and bring to a boil. Cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced by half, about 4 minutes. Stir in mussels; cover and cook over high, shaking and tossing the pot at 1 minute intervals, until mussels are opened, 5 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat (see notes); stir in lemon zest and juice and parsley. Serve with French fries and mayonnaise.

schema_metadata.keywords: moules frites, moules-frites, frites et moules, frites moules, moules aux frites

description: With an aromatic broth for sopping up with fries or chunks of bread, these briny little mussels make even the most mundane weeknight feel like a night out at a bistro.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Mayonnaise, homemade or store-bought, for serving

Optional substitutions: french fries → frozen french fries

Notes: If mussels are gritty or have lots of beards, scrub them well under cold water and pull out beards by grabbing them and pulling towards the hinge-end of the mussels. Discard cracked or open mussels that don’t close when tapped with another mussel.
Discard any mussels that remain unopened after cooking.
To toss the mussels in the pot, use your thumbs to secure the lid, and toss the pot up and down a couple of times to allow mussels on top to settle towards the base of the pan.
author: Genevieve Yam
